title: God Awful Gun
body:
### Check out this (not) amazing "Gun" I made!
**Featuring:**

_Gun: shoots a overpowered Bullet_

**Recipe:**
- Redstone on the top.
- Lever in the middle.
- Netherite ingot on the left and top left corner.
- Iron ingot on the right, bottom left corner, and top right corner.

_Bullet: the ammo for the gun (if in creative you do not need the bullet)_

**Recipe:**
- Gold ingot on the bottom.
- Red dye on the top.
